When a [[Scout ship/Legends|exploration vessel]] from [[The galaxy/Legends|the greater galaxy]] stumbled upon the [[O'reen system/Legends|O'reen system]] several centuries<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> before the [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[O'reenian]]s captured the [[Starship/Legends|starship]]; nevertheless the encounter compelled the '''Magnus''', leader of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], to press for greater technological advancement of the [[O'reenian]]s to better defend the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from outside forces. The program eventually led O'reen to become technologically matched to most of the outside galaxy.<ref name="UR" />
